definition: Candace Lee (Candy) Sidner is an American computer scientist whose research has applied artificial intelligence and natural language processing to problems in personal information management, intelligent user interfaces, and human–robot interaction.
details: She is a retired research professor of computer science at the Worcester Polytechnic Institute and a former president of the Association for Computational Linguistics. She is a Fellow of the Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence, and a Fellow of the Association of Computational Linguistics.
